kind: Controlled EditMode production RaceCanvas instruments preview; no live race, track, badge or gameplay manager. Gear selection/lock/input-disabled are isolated presentation snapshots, never a simulated gameplay settlement.
scaling: Production reference 1920x1080, width/height match 0.5; same-aspect captures use width/1920
lifecycle: Controlled EditMode manually calls HUD.Start and production ApplyLayout/Bind, then the existing presentation Refresh APIs. Native owned standings ScrollRect LateUpdate supplies its normal render stage. Cleanup explicitly detaches owned shell TMP subscriptions. Each stage covers six teams, three sizes and selected/confirmed/disabled fixtures. Disabled uses the supported zero-capacity HeatPool guard, never a zero gear or invented zero-card rule.
